proof_scope: tau#363 dev-cycle workflowScript controller properties proven over a simulated runs runner against the committed artifact

claims.proves: The committed workflows/dev-cycle.workflow.js enforces the council controller properties in code (evidence-chain digests, lease fencing with guarded release, contamination guard, final-audit veto, post-round re-gate, mid-round provider rebind, restart journal, convergence detection, gap synthesis) via a real node:test sandbox harness dispatching scripted scenarios; a corrupted scenario copy fails the harness.
claims.does_not_prove: Live provider/model quality, real gh-land or ticket-skill mutation behavior, readiness-command correctness on the target repo, or any unattended production run of the workflow.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: The dev-cycle workflowScript terminal states and lane decisions are bound by controller code properties exercised through a deterministic simulated-runs harness over the committed script bytes.
